_about: Public-domain John McClintock (1814-1870), Methodist scholar, editor of the Methodist Quarterly Review and first president of Drew Theological Seminary, for the Word Hoard: Living Words (unwritten sermons) and his discourse on the day of Lincoln's funeral. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 110 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

mcclintock-lincoln: Discourse delivered on the day of the funeral of President Lincoln, Wednesday, April 19, 1865, in St. Paul's Church, New York (New York : Press of J.M. Bradstreet & Son, 1865)
mcclintock-living-words: Living words; or, Unwritten sermons (New York : Carlton & Lanahan; San Francisco E. Thomas [etc., etc.], 1871)
